transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1590 West Vista Glen Loop?

Yes. Five people. Father needs help leaving — he’s in a manual wheelchair. No water inside yet.

Got it. Father needs help leaving. No water inside yet. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.
